## Content notes
- Product prices, stock and promotions can change; use the current product page as the source of truth.
- Products that require a prescription are subject to pharmaceutical review before purchase is released.
- Product and medication information on the site is informational and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.
- Administrative, account, cart, checkout and payment pages are transactional and should not be treated as public reference content.
